results.title: Zamboanga City rolls out free EV charging stations for public use
results.description: ZAMBOANGA CITY — The city government here has installed three electric vehicle (EV) charging stations at the City Hall grounds for free public use. City Administrator Percival Ramos, who supervised the installation work, said in a statement on Thursday that two of the three EV charging stations were installed in front of the City Hall for free public use. “The other one, located inside City Hall premises, will be for use of city-owned electric vehicles,” Ramos said. He said the move is timely, as the city government is shifting toward sustainable mobility with the expected delivery of three electric pickup units. Mayor [...]...
